physics.note: angular speed is set at the edge and does not change in flight; fall time goes as sqrt(h). Four times the height is twice the turn.

audio.music: a low pedal that drops a fifth at the turn of the argument, and one struck note on the last line
audio.sfx: all synthesised in ink-theater/sfx.py — a wet slap and a dry clack are the punchline; the fall whoosh rises as v^2 and flutters once per half turn

brand.subscribe: InkBrand.subscribe() at 57.60, and the tap clicks

delivery_encode.shipped: x264 CRF 20 preset slow, audio muxed in the same pass

providers_used: none — zero API keys, zero generated images, zero stock, zero licensed audio
